newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Former Rothwells officials sentenced to jail.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Former Rothwells officials sentenced to jail.

text.p: The former independent auditor of Perth-based Rothwells Ltd, Louis James Carter, was sentenced in the Western Australian Supreme Court on Monday to four years and three months jail following his conviction on conspiracy and false accounting charges relating to the failed merchant bank.
Carter's co-defendant Peter Lucas was also sentenced to four years jail on similar charges.
Both will be eligible for parole, and the normal remissions and should be out of jail after serving 17 and 16 months respectively.
The sentence will run from November 26, the date of the conviction.
Lucas, the former managing director of Rothwells, and Carter stood impassively in the dock as the sentences were handed down.

Justice Kerry White said his sentences reflected the fact that the defendants had had the charges "hanging over their heads for many years" and each had been deprived of their freedom of movement since their trial began in November 1995.
